subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c713abc8ecdb8ee075ac9e5268b35d006b9a05a282721ba4c99ed8da7add362.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) LH - QM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25716e96e91acbe0145269a132ff210bca1b66826f84084fee1c338a5fc39e2e.png] 

Option 2) KF - MH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d29248b90f4700395a18cb7ab535c47ed958ea50ee99734dc5d16b2efb5cb4c1.png] 

Option 3) QL - SN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/baaf601d3e4736e5a2152de52219de88441758cc7b75bf9f24dfce028c76b5d7.png] 

Option 4) EZ - GB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e0482b16a2209598d0c38a60bd7580830c475858439f1a3427d0e4a09637565.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
